text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- President Lennart Meri appointed five new ministers on Sunday, ending the search of Prime Minister Tiit Vaehi for a new government, which will be a minority adminstration.
- The right-wing Pro Patria party urged the government not to sign a border deal with Russia until it holds a referendum on the issue.
- The Democratic Labour Party declared that it no longer considered itself the legal successor of the Estonian Communist Party.
- Estonian Olympic cyclist Erika Salumae intends to leave sport and take up politics.
- The rural parties in the government coalition intend to get customs tariffs introduced as soon as possible, leader Arnold Ruutel said.
